entities.summary: José María Leandro Gómez Calvo, better known as Leandro Gómez was a Uruguayan military officer and politician. A member of the National Party, he is best remembered for his heroical defense during the Siege of Paysandú in 1864.

entities.summary: José María Leandro Gómez Calvo, better known as Leandro Gómez was a Uruguayan military officer and politician. A member of the National Party, he is best remembered for his heroical defense during the Siege of Paysandú in 1864.
